title: graphics.palette.decode result
description: Every colour the run holds, in both encodings, beside a count of the words that are not $0RGB.

colors_rgb8.description: The same colours as [r, g, b] triples. Both encodings travel together because deriving one from the other separately in each frontend is how two of them end up showing different colours.

invalid_words.description: Words whose high nibble is not zero, so are not $0RGB at all. Counted rather than refused: a table with one stray entry is still the table, and the count is what tells a caller guessing at an offset whether the guess was good.
